brief: The canvas presents a continuous, interconnected grid of squares set against a dark background. Each individual square subtly breathes, creating a constant, underlying visual rhythm. When the user clicks anywhere on the canvas, an expanding wave ripples outward from the impact point. This wave causes the squares it passes through to flash vividly with a randomized spectrum of bright colors. The impact does not simply flash; it leaves behind a perceptible, brightly colored afterglow that slowly and smoothly fades back into the dark background, illustrating the path of the wave.

statement: This sketch creates a dynamic grid of subtly breathing squares on a dark background, where each square gently pulses with its own color. When the user clicks anywhere on the canvas, an expanding ripple wave emanates from the click point. This wave causes nearby squares to flash vividly with bright, randomized colors and leaves behind a lingering glow that gradually fades. The visual rhythm is both continuous and responsive — the base grid breathes slowly while interactions create immediate, colorful disruptions that propagate outward in smooth, animated ripples.
